production_concerns.finding: 'Expires in {days} days' and '{count} days' are used for every count, so one day reads 'Expires in 1 days' / '1 days' in English (Vietnamese has no plural). Not encoded as a failing test.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Add singular keys (expiryDay, attentionUnitDay) chosen by describeExpiry/NeedsAttentionPanel when the count is 1, or word it neutrally ('Expires in: {days} day(s)').

production_concerns.finding:
When all four compact sections (staff, academics, support, billing) are FORBIDDEN the component still returns the slot wrapper with an empty grid (verified: '
'), leaving an empty md:col-span-2 / xl:col-span-6 cell and an extra gap. Cosmetic; HOST_ADMIN sees all four.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Return null when all four sections are FORBIDDEN (use sectionAvailability).

production_concerns.finding: The mappers destructure required sections without optional chaining. A payload that omits a section (older backend) throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading status)' and the route error boundary takes over instead of hiding that widget. The api-client type says every section is always present, so this is a contract-drift hazard only.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Optional: treat an undefined section as FORBIDDEN in sectionAvailability/sectionData and guard the destructured reads.

production_concerns.finding: Only the 7 mutations named in the plan invalidate the overview. Other mutations change numbers on it (active classes, unassigned/active learners, session status counts and upcoming list, enrolled counts, open tickets). The overview can be up to 30 s stale after them (staleTime) when the user returns quickly.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Optional: add the same one-line invalidateQueries({ queryKey: HOST_DASHBOARD_QUERY_KEY }) to those hooks, or accept the 30 s staleness.

production_concerns.finding: When some sources failed and nothing else is waiting, the panel shows 'Nothing needs your attention right now.' together with 'Some checks could not be loaded.' The first sentence is reassuring while checks are missing. No test pins the all-clear sentence in that state.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Hide the all-clear sentence while failed > 0 (or word it 'Nothing needs attention in the checks that loaded').

production_concerns.finding: Dead code: quickActionsLabel is never read, HOST_DASHBOARD_ROUTES.classes is never used, and the DashboardSlot type is never imported. Local constants FULL_PERCENT (SeatUsageBlock.tsx:12) and PERCENT_MAX (GradingPipelinePanel.tsx:17) duplicate PERCENT_SCALE (constants.ts:18).
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Remove the unused entries (or use quickActionsLabel as the aria-label of the quick-action group) and reuse PERCENT_SCALE.

production_concerns.finding: The donut total prints '1200 learners' without a thousands separator while every other number on the page is locale-grouped ('1,200' / '1.200'). The total text comes from the shared chart, not from the feature.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Let StatusDonutChart accept a valueFormatter (as the trend charts do) and pass formatNumber.

production_concerns.finding: Server rendering uses the default locale of the @pte/ui provider (Vietnamese) for the package's own chrome, so in English renders the collapse button ('Thu gon') and DataTable sort labels ('Sap xep theo ...') stay Vietnamese. Only the dashboard copy is switched. Not a product defect; it limits what the English render tests can say about library chrome.
